thread:
elaine_support: Customer reported a 413 from /v1/rerank with 'payload too large' but their UI shows a short query + ~50 docs. they say it worked yesterday.
elain_support: i asked for the raw request, they pasted a compressed view that still looks fine. sharing here.
omar_eng: can you paste the exact curl? sometimes base64 or encoded attachments blow token counts.
elaine_support: original excerpt:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "Long product description text from search box... (truncated)",
  "docs": [ {"id":1, "text": "<very long html blob>"}, ... 50 items ]
}
```
elaine_support: customer says they send docs generated by our web crawler + raw HTML fragments.
omar_eng: html fragments are the usual culprit. HTML tags and embedded scripts massively inflate tokenization vs char count. also lots of repeated boilerplate.
tina_pm: customer visible error is just '413 Payload Too Large' with no guidance. they asked if it's a hard limit and how to avoid.
kevin_sre: from runtime logs i can see the request was rejected at the parser stage with token estimate ~112k and our rerank limit is 64k tokens for that model family. i'll attach traces.
kevin_sre: stack trace snippet: 
```
[rerank] parse_input -> estimate_tokens() => 112478
reject: input_token_limit_exceeded (max_allowed=65536)
```
elaine_support: can we give the customer a remediation path and a clear repro to test locally?
omar_eng: suggested steps for them: 1) strip HTML -> send plain text 2) truncate docs to summary (<= 400 tokens) 3) send fewer docs per request and batch in multiple calls 4) use our embeddings pre-filtering to shortlist docs before rerank. share sample code: 
```
# naive html stripper + chunking pseudo
text = strip_html(raw_html)
summary = summarize(text, max_tokens=350)
batches = chunk_docs(summaries, batch_size=10)
for b in batches:
  call_rerank(query, b)
```
elaine_support: customer tried stripping tags and success improved; they still want a better UX: error should say which field triggered (query vs docs) and include their token count and the model limit.
tina_pm: agree — adds to docs backlog. propose two short fixes: (1) change 413 body to JSON with {"error":"input_token_limit_exceeded","field":"docs[3]","tokens":112478,"max_tokens":65536} (2) add quick KB article for '413 from rerank' with examples and chunking recipes.
omar_eng: implementable. runtime already computes estimate and identifies largest doc index. surface that in the error. security review ok as long as we don't echo full doc contents, just index and counts.
kevin_sre: can add rate-limited logging id so customer can reference a support id. e.g., include request_id in response.
docs_bot: creating KB draft: https://redwood-internal/docs/support/rerank-413-guidance (draft created by docs_bot)
elaine_support: i'm sending the customer a reproduction checklist and the immediate workaround steps. will update here when they confirm.
omar_eng: follow-up engineering tasks: change error shape (support), add token-estimate debug flag, telemetry event for input_overflow. i'll file a small PR.
tina_pm: prioritize as P1 for UX on rerank error messaging. please add estimated effort.
omar_eng: estimate 2 dev days + 1 docs day + 1 QA.
elaine_support: customer patched client to strip html and now reports rerank success. closing loop with them, will paste final payload sizes. thanks all. :party_parrot:
